app.title: sgRNA Oligo Designer
app.summary: A person uploads a table of guide sequences with their identifiers, or loads the bundled example, and optionally supplies an empty vector map plus the placeholder sequence inside it that the guide will replace. Column names and the fixed 5' and 3' flanking sequences added to each strand can be overridden before running. Running cleans and checks every sequence, builds a sense and antisense ordering pair for each one, and inserts each guide into the vector map; a summary line and a preview table show what was produced. The person then downloads a synthesis-vendor order spreadsheet and a combined annotated sequence-map file for later verification.

task.text: Turn a table of target sequences into a ready-to-upload oligo order form and annotated construct maps for cloning.

data.text: A spreadsheet or delimited table of short DNA target sequences with identifiers, plus an annotated circular vector sequence with its features and a placeholder stretch to be replaced.
data.item: one 20-nucleotide guide sequence with its identifier, and the construct built from it

stage.text: planning a cloning experiment after targets are chosen, before ordering reagents

mechanism.text: A sidebar collects the input files and the parameters, in numbered steps with tooltips and a collapsible advanced panel, and a single run button drives the whole computation; the main panel shows a one-line summary, a table preview of the generated order rows, and two download buttons. Status is fed back inline as a source indicator under the stuffer fields and as a transient notification after each run.

steps.step: compute a value from the data
steps.here: one run button cleans each sequence, checks its alphabet and length, builds the two complementary strands per item, and inserts each into the reference; a notification reports how many items became how many products

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: a summary line counts items and products and says whether map output is ready, and the order rows are previewed as a table before anything is downloaded
two buttons save the vendor order spreadsheet, named after the uploaded file, and a single combined annotated map file under a chosen filename stem

distinctive: the placeholder stretch must occur exactly once across both strands of the circular reference, and must not be its own reverse complement, or the insertion is refused with a specific reason

insertion keeps the reference's own annotations, drops any annotation lying wholly inside the replaced stretch, shifts downstream coordinates when lengths differ, and adds a new labelled feature at the site
sequences are silently repaired on the way in: whitespace from copy-paste removed, case normalised, with warnings for off-length entries and for an apparent adjacency motif left on the end
the exported spreadsheet reproduces a vendor's bulk-upload template exactly, down to fixed scale and purification columns, header font and column widths
each item yields two products, a forward and a reverse-complement strand with asymmetric flanking sequences, so counts are reported as items and as twice the items
